finding: The prior unretained ~1% regression is not reproducible. The isolated route cuts the traced layer-2 MoE role 371.104->88.125 ms (4.211x), including Q5_K gate/up 279.863->16.656 ms. Same-process counterbalanced p508 improves 5.34%, and every one of 20 category-balanced p512 pairs is faster (mean ratio 1.0498, descriptive 95% CI 1.0483-1.0514). Both routes repeat exactly within mode but logits differ across modes, so the candidate remains default-off pending the complete production-profile gate.

correctness.current_evidence: same-route deterministic logits and same final top-1 token on p508 and all four p512 categories; earlier 8-heldout final-row screen passed at mean/max KL 0.0078/0.0197 and 100% top-1
correctness.binding_gap: Cross-route logits differ. The current stacked profile still requires 450 rows x 3 repeats, category/shape/transition tails, tasks, state, physical c2/isolation, lifecycle, manifest, and strict fallback gates before promotion.

decision.next: Run the complete current-stack production gate; if it passes, add explicit layer-2 Q5_K manifest ownership, bind the route only in production, retain strict selected gemv fallback, then run p512/p1024/p4096 plus tg128.

limitations: p508 and p512 A/Bs measure prefill only; decode is unaffected by this rows>=16 route but canonical tg128 still binds at promotion.
Only p508 has a role trace; canonical p512 categories have same-process wall/output evidence.
The candidate is T2 and cannot be retained merely from stable top-1 or the earlier eight-row heldout screen.
No new kernel was implemented; this reopens qualification of an existing registered candidate.
